content.comment_body: Hello, I'm new to this forum. I'm currently working with [company_name] [product_name] [version_no] demo version, using it for simulation as part of my coursework. I've run into an obstacle on the final part of my simulation and could use some guidance. I'm attempting to set up a countdown using a pulse generator and a counter, and I want the M4 flag contacts to turn off when the counter reaches zero—essentially simulating the motor shutting down. Triggering the countdown works, but once it hits zero, the make contact doesn't activate as expected. I've tried using a normally closed contact and adjusting settings, but either the counter doesn't activate the make contact, or the normally closed setup results in the line being incorrectly live from the start. I appreciate any help. I'm building my simulation with the Ladder Diagram.
You need to assign the value 1 to both parameters (ON and OFF).
Thank you very much. That solution helped me resolve the issue.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced challenges setting up a countdown sequence with a counter and pulse generator in a simulation tool from [company_name], needing the counter output to change states when reaching zero. The primary usability issue relates to limited in-app guidance on how certain parameter values impact relay behavior, especially for beginners using the software for learning and simulation purposes.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the simulation software to provide straightforward control over elements like counters and flags, mirroring real-world logical diagrams, as well as clear and accessible documentation to support educational activities.
